scenarios.reason: no allowlisted recipient found among the candidates, so a cap test would revert for the wrong reason
scenarios.why: a single payment must not exceed the per-tx cap
the spending key must not be able to change the rules or unpause
a bounded rail must still pay, otherwise the test proves nothing but a dead contract

note: Rogue scenarios are broadcast only after a static call proved they revert, so a reverted transaction here is evidence of containment rather than a failed attempt at theft.
